transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 174 Williamstown Drive?

Sí, soy yo en 174 Williamstown Drive.  
Estoy bien, no hay agua adentro y no necesito ayuda.
Understood, you’re at 174 Williamstown Drive and safe. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Sí, cinco personas están aquí. Todos pueden ayudar, no hay nadie que no pueda salir solo.

Gracias por confirmar, entiendo la situación. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No, nadie necesita ayuda especial. Todo está bien.
Understood, everything is fine as stated. Is there water inside the home right now?
No, no hay agua adentro. Todo está bien.
Understood, no water inside, everything is fine. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No tengo camión con buena altura, ni bote, ni asientos libres en ningún vehículo.
Understood, no high-clearance truck, boat, or free seats available. Let me read that back: 5 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Sí, cinco personas, sin agua adentro. Todo bien.
Gracias por confirmar, todo bien. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
